name: watakyu-video
description: 一枚のシーツから世界へ ― 職場見学 学習用解説動画（Remotion）

scripts.music: python3 tools/music.py && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i public/music/bgm.wav -c:a aac -b:a 192k public/music/bgm.m4a && rm public/music/bgm.wav
scripts.docs: node tools/make-script-md.mjs v2 && node tools/make-script-md.mjs v1
scripts.render:main: npm run glyphs && remotion render src/index.ts Main out/raw_main_v2.mp4 && tools/finalize.sh out/raw_main_v2.mp4 deliverables/watakyu_main_v2.mp4
scripts.render:full: npm run glyphs && remotion render src/index.ts Full out/raw_full_v2.mp4 && tools/finalize.sh out/raw_full_v2.mp4 deliverables/watakyu_full_v2.mp4
scripts.build: npm run srt && npm run docs && npm run render:main && npm run render:full
scripts.verify: python3 tools/verify_sync.py deliverables/watakyu_main_v2.mp4 main v2 && python3 tools/verify_sync.py deliverables/watakyu_full_v2.mp4 full v2 && python3 tools/compare_voices.py && python3 tools/compare_voices.py deliverables/watakyu_main_v2.mp4 main && python3 tools/compare_voices.py deliverables/watakyu_full_v2.mp4 full
scripts.render:main:v1: npm run glyphs && remotion render src/index.ts MainV1 out/raw_main.mp4 && tools/finalize.sh out/raw_main.mp4 deliverables/watakyu_main.mp4
scripts.render:full:v1: npm run glyphs && remotion render src/index.ts FullV1 out/raw_full.mp4 && tools/finalize.sh out/raw_full.mp4 deliverables/watakyu_full.mp4
